PSA

Seems like a lot of people here have a sound sensitivity disorder called Misophonia. I've struggled with it growing up, but fortunately there's therapy you can do yourself that can help!

Buy some comfy in-ear headphones and play white noise from your phone, just loud enough that you can still hear normally.

It doesn't block out the noise, but instead desensitizes you to your triggers. I was part of a clinical trial when I was younger which did exactly this and It worked pretty well.

Keep in mind that you're retraining your brain to disassociate the sound, so it can take several weeks to months to improve.

Downvoating is what reddit uses to silence dissenting views.

People don't typically upvoat, even if they like something. They will just look at it.

Look, our entire political system should make it more practical. We don't let everyone vote in elections for a good reason: we know that retards are the majority of people.
